The '''Xanaqu Ministry of Industry and Technology''' is a government ministry of the [[People's Federation of Xanaqu]] named in the extracted [[Xanaqu South Industrial State Cooperation]] source.

The source says XSISC operates under the ministry's oversight so that its industrial, civilian, and defense activities align with national economic and defense strategy.

== Role ==

For the 1994-back draft set, the ministry is useful because it explains how Xanaqu's state-owned industry connects to national planning. It likely coordinates major manufacturing priorities, research and development, industrial modernization, and defense-industrial production, but those specific powers are not yet fixed by source material.

The ministry should be reviewed alongside the [[Central Workers Council]] before publication so that Xanaqu's state structure is not overbuilt from one corporate source.
